Plot source-scientific FPCA fixed-target bootstrap score uncertainty

etr_plot_fpca_score_uncertainty.Rd

The existing native bootstrap estimator supplies each fixed target's percentile interval. The plot does not refit, recalibrate or add future-target measurement uncertainty. Source Matplotlib artist arrays and axes are compared to the frozen public Python 1.2 function, but native R graphics and Python figure runtime/pixel rendering remain distinct.

Usage

etr_plot_fpca_score_uncertainty(
    result, component = 0L, max_targets = 30L,
    strict_source_record = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

result

Actual native FPCA score uncertainty result with reference scores, bootstrap medians, lower and upper percentile endpoints for fixed identified targets.

component

Python-compatible zero-based FPC component index.

max_targets

Positive integer limit on the original ordered fixed target curves shown.

strict_source_record

If TRUE, retain frozen Python 1.2 Matplotlib scientific errorbar, original reference-score scatter, zero line, tick labels and source plot metadata in a typed native R record. This does not return Python Matplotlib Axes.

...

Native base-R plot options.

Value

Default invisible target-curve median, lower, upper and full-sample reference score table; strict mode returns an inspectable one-panel source scientific artist record with asymmetric error-bar matrix, reference scatter offsets, plot labels and zero reference.
